استحقروا (form X)
# اِسْتَحْقَرُوا (istaḥqarū) /is.taħ.qa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اُسْتُحْقِرُوا (ustuḥqirū) /us.tuħ.qi.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
# اِسْتَحْقِرُوا (istaḥqirū) /is.taħ.qi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَحْقَرَ (istaḥqara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
